                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              logical implementation of expressly specified collision/completeness condition, not new legal clearance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • value
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              body/furniture/door dimensions from selected profile only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              authority
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source-profile constant; no universal .7 body/.6 closet law

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  وضعیت پیاده‌سازی، جدا از قرارداد

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  basis
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source registry snapshot and actual225 reconciliation; not inferred from a written criterion
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  historical_code
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  No current-source/applicability legal validator
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  known_historical_gap
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Schematic geometry not legal compliance. Keep source-مرجع فنی ثبت‌شده; no blanket legal gate or fabricated exemption.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  current_final_claim
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NOT_PROVEN_COMPLETE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  separate_actual_evidence
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  مرجع فنی ثبت‌شده
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  IR-L02

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  متن بند در منبع

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  تعیین دامنه ۱۲ نوامبر ۲۰۲۶: هر بخش این بند درباره کفایت نور/تهویه یا تأیید فنی و اجرای پله/آسانسور فقط POST_MVP / NOT_EVALUATED است و گیت MVP نیست؛ سایر کنترل‌های هندسی و کارکردیِ داخل دامنه محفوظ‌اند. IR-L02 | نور و تهویه آشپزخانه. برای نوع مستقل/باز/دیواری؛ بخش ۴-۵-۵-۳ نسخه۱۳۹۶ در L-S01 با زیرحالت مربوط و متن کامل تطبیق شود. روش: نوع آشپزخانه، بازشو و مسیر تخلیه؛ بدون مشخصات تهویه فقط پتانسیل گزارش شود، نه انطباق.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  رابطه و الگوریتم دقیق

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Determine applicable legal jurisdiction, official edition/amendments, building/use class and exact cited subclause from authenticated source; a bibliography pointer is not an executable requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    If current MVP exclusion applies return N_A; otherwise missing official clause or applicability data returns UNKNOWN SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, never invent numeric limits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Only after separately reviewed clause formalization, evaluate its explicitly defined measurement basis and branch; this document supplies no unverified legal comparator.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  شرط پذیرش محدود

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  no present legal PASS is defined; future activated clause needs separate versioned formalization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  شرط رد اثبات‌شده

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  condition
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  no legal noncompliance inferred from unverified clause; known functional failure belongs to active H/IR-P rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  effect
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  review contradiction/trade-off or invalid evidence; no hard rejection inferred from preference

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  شرط نامعلوم

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  applicability unresolved, missing/null source/profile/scenario/role/geometry/alternative coverage; unproved failed search; unsupported operation dimension; bound/deadline exhausted. Preserve independent proven violations; never turn missing into PASS. متنکاملشاخه/نسخه/شمول برایآینده لازم.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  شرط خارج از دامنه

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  current scope ledger excludes/defer assessment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unapproved_assumptions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    no_new_numeric_thresholds
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    True
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    remaining
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    متنکاملشاخه/نسخه/شمول برایآینده لازم.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unsupported_computation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    UNKNOWN, not a synthetic authority flag

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          IR-L03

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          متن بند در منبع

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          تعیین دامنه ۱۲ نوامبر ۲۰۲۶: هر بخش این بند درباره کفایت نور/تهویه یا تأیید فنی و اجرای پله/آسانسور فقط POST_MVP / NOT_EVALUATED است و گیت MVP نیست؛ سایر کنترل‌های هندسی و کارکردیِ داخل دامنه محفوظ‌اند. IR-L03 | فضای بهداشتی. برای WC/حمام و آرایش ادغام/تفکیک؛ بخش ۴-۵-۶ نسخه۱۳۹۶ در L-S01. ابعاد مفید، تجهیزات، دسترسی و تهویه به بند دقیق و شمول مرتبط شوند. عدد عمومی بدون مبنای اندازه‌گیری درج نشود.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          رابطه و الگوریتم دقیق

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Determine applicable legal jurisdiction, official edition/amendments, building/use class and exact cited subclause from authenticated source; a bibliography pointer is not an executable requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            If current MVP exclusion applies return N_A; otherwise missing official clause or applicability data returns UNKNOWN SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, never invent numeric limits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Only after separately reviewed clause formalization, evaluate its explicitly defined measurement basis and branch; this document supplies no unverified legal comparator.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          شرط پذیرش محدود

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          no present legal PASS is defined; future activated clause needs separate versioned formalization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          شرط رد اثبات‌شده

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          condition
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          no legal noncompliance inferred from unverified clause; known functional failure belongs to active H/IR-P rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          effect
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          review contradiction/trade-off or invalid evidence; no hard rejection inferred from preference

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          شرط نامعلوم

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          applicability unresolved, missing/null source/profile/scenario/role/geometry/alternative coverage; unproved failed search; unsupported operation dimension; bound/deadline exhausted. Preserve independent proven violations; never turn missing into PASS. بنددقیق۴-۵-۶ ونسخه/شرایطادغام‌تفکیک تأیید نشده.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          شرط خارج از دامنه

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          guard proven false; mixed excluded subclauses separately N_A, not the whole active requirement

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          آستانه و نوع اعتبار

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • value
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            zero prohibited positive-area intersections / all required inventory IDs covered
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            authority
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            logical implementation of expressly specified collision/completeness condition, not new legal clearance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • value
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            body/furniture/door dimensions from selected profile only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            authority
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source-profile constant; no universal .7 body/.6 closet law

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          فرض‌ها

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          source_vs_engineering
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          authority
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Owner/source text controls scope; operational predicate is transparent reconciliation, not new enacted law or empirical proof.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          predicate_status
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SOURCE_DERIVED_OPERATIONALIZATION_NOT_RUNTIME_VALIDATED
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          research_sources
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Sxx references retained in full original text; project narratives/studies are not universal laws.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unapproved_assumptions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No invented orientation, terrace requirement, legal threshold, area ratio or technical certification.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          no_new_numeric_thresholds
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          True
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          remaining
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          بنددقیق۴-۵-۶ ونسخه/شرایطادغام‌تفکیک تأیید نشده.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unsupported_computation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          UNKNOWN, not a synthetic authority flag

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                IR-L04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                متن بند در منبع

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                IR-L04 | پله، خروج، دسترس‌پذیری و بازشو. در طراحی کامل ساختمان نیازمند منابع رسمی جاری و شرایط طبقات/جمعیت/ارتفاع است؛ در این پژوهش مجموعه بندهای لازم تأیید نشده. H15 فقط رزرو دوبعدی است؛ این ردیف برای ادعای کامل قانونی نامشخص/بررسی‌نشده می‌ماند و طراحی تمام ساختمان خارج دامنه گزارش می‌شود.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                رابطه و الگوریتم دقیق

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Determine applicable legal jurisdiction, official edition/amendments, building/use class and exact cited subclause from authenticated source; a bibliography pointer is not an executable requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  If current MVP exclusion applies return N_A; otherwise missing official clause or applicability data returns UNKNOWN SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, never invent numeric limits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Only after separately reviewed clause formalization, evaluate its explicitly defined measurement basis and branch; this document supplies no unverified legal comparator.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                شرط پذیرش محدود

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                no present legal PASS is defined; future activated clause needs separate versioned formalization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                شرط رد اثبات‌شده

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                condition
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                no legal noncompliance inferred from unverified clause; known functional failure belongs to active H/IR-P rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                effect
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                review contradiction/trade-off or invalid evidence; no hard rejection inferred from preference

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                شرط نامعلوم

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                applicability unresolved, missing/null source/profile/scenario/role/geometry/alternative coverage; unproved failed search; unsupported operation dimension; bound/deadline exhausted. Preserve independent proven violations; never turn missing into PASS. مجموعهبندهایجاری وشرایط ساختمان دراینپژوهش تأییدنشده. حدود دقیق حرکت درهای هسته که مستقیماً مصوب نشده‌اند باید جدا نامعلوم بمانند، نه حذف کل دسترس و نه الزام اختراعی.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                شرط خارج از دامنه

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                current scope ledger excludes/defer assessment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        IR-L05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        متن بند در منبع

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        IR-L05 | اقلیم، انرژی، صوت، سازه و تأسیسات. بسته مقرراتی جامع این حوزه‌ها در این پژوهش تأیید نشده؛ شهر به‌تنهایی شاهد انطباق نیست. در MVP بررسی کامل خارج دامنه است؛ ثبت «نامربوط به ارزیابی جاری، نه معاف از قانون» همراه مرز ادعا لازم است. بررسی محدود هر بند در آینده ردیف و نسخه اختصاصی می‌گیرد.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        رابطه و الگوریتم دقیق

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Determine applicable legal jurisdiction, official edition/amendments, building/use class and exact cited subclause from authenticated source; a bibliography pointer is not an executable requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If current MVP exclusion applies return N_A; otherwise missing official clause or applicability data returns UNKNOWN SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, never invent numeric limits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Only after separately reviewed clause formalization, evaluate its explicitly defined measurement basis and branch; this document supplies no unverified legal comparator.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط پذیرش محدود

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        no present legal PASS is defined; future activated clause needs separate versioned formalization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط رد اثبات‌شده

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        condition
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        no legal noncompliance inferred from unverified clause; known functional failure belongs to active H/IR-P rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        effect
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        review contradiction/trade-off or invalid evidence; no hard rejection inferred from preference

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط نامعلوم

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        applicability unresolved, missing/null source/profile/scenario/role/geometry/alternative coverage; unproved failed search; unsupported operation dimension; bound/deadline exhausted. Preserve independent proven violations; never turn missing into PASS. منبع/ویرایش/شمول هر حوزه بایدآینده مستقلاًتعیین شود.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط خارج از دامنه

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        current scope ledger excludes/defer assessment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  preconditions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  same candidate readset; proved applicable counterexample for geometry repair; preference action only approved goal and quantified trade-off; unknown never authorizes blind redesign
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  forbidden_edits
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • change W/L/n or required program silently
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • shrink source furniture/body/clearance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • delete failed scenarios or gates
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • relabel residual/route as function
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • activate excluded technical/light requirements

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • input dimensions and unit count

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • fixed source asset sizes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • owner scope and exclusions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  all evidence whose geometry/program/profile/scenario/readset changes, plus local/world/export bindings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  rechecks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • fresh source reconstruction and replay
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • all applicable hard H rules
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • all affected IR/Q and owner overlays
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • both units and both frames
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • privacy/access/operations/usable living/per-unit comparison
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • render/export identity if affected
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  terminal_condition
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unknown source/action domain, unknown mandatory evidence, no distinct authorized action, exhausted declared budget, or unresolved forbidden trade-off => STOP_UNRESOLVED; never deliver blocked
