                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                IR-L06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                متن بند در منبع

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                IR-L06 | نوع L مشروط | شمول و ابعاد فضای باز نورگیر شرط کاربرد: وقتی از حیاطک/پاسیو برای ادعای تأمین نور و هوا استفاده می‌شود. پیش از حدگذاری: نوع فضای باز، کاربری اتاق‌های وابسته، مساحت واقعی زمین در برابر قاب طراحی، گروه و ارتفاع ساختمان، پنجره‌های روبه‌رو و استقلال تصرف‌ها، ضوابط محلی و ویرایش/اصلاحیه منبع روشن شود. ارجاع برای بازبینی: مبحث۴ نسخه۱۳۹۶، بخش ۴-۵-۸-۳ و مقررات اختصاصی مسکونی/نورگیری مرتبط؛ این ارجاع فهرست جست‌وجو است و بسته بندهای اجرایی تأییدشده نیست. دسترسی جاری به لینک رسمی قدیمی ناموفق بود و آخرین مجموعه رسمی لازم‌الاجرا/شمول محلی تأیید نشد. اعداد رایج ۶/۱۲ مترمربع یا ۳/۶ درصد، بدون شاخه و شرایط مربوط وارد قاعده فعال نمی‌شوند. مساحت مستطیل MVP خودکار مساحت ثبتی زمین نیست. نتیجه پیش‌فرض در فقدان منبع و داده: نامشخص / SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED یا INPUT_REQUIRED. خارج‌بودن طراحی کل ساختمان از MVP، معافیت حقوقی نورگیر نیست. هیچ تخفیف ابعادی یا تأیید شهرداری با این افزوده صادر نمی‌شود.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                رابطه و الگوریتم دقیق

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Determine applicable legal jurisdiction, official edition/amendments, building/use class and exact cited subclause from authenticated source; a bibliography pointer is not an executable requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  If current MVP exclusion applies return N_A; otherwise missing official clause or applicability data returns UNKNOWN SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, never invent numeric limits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Only after separately reviewed clause formalization, evaluate its explicitly defined measurement basis and branch; this document supplies no unverified legal comparator.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                شرط پذیرش محدود

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                no present legal PASS is defined; future activated clause needs separate versioned formalization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                شرط رد اثبات‌شده

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                condition
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                no legal noncompliance inferred from unverified clause; known functional failure belongs to active H/IR-P rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                effect
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                review contradiction/trade-off or invalid evidence; no hard rejection inferred from preference

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                شرط نامعلوم

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                applicability unresolved, missing/null source/profile/scenario/role/geometry/alternative coverage; unproved failed search; unsupported operation dimension; bound/deadline exhausted. Preserve independent proven violations; never turn missing into PASS. بسته بندهای۴-۵-۸-۳/مسکونی،نسخهجاری،ارتفاع وحقوقهمسایگی تأییدنشده.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                شرط خارج از دامنه

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                current scope ledger excludes/defer assessment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        O-INPUT-5-45

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        رابطه و الگوریتم دقیق

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Bind raw request identity/revision and preserve original W/L/n tokens, including explicit absent fields. Normalize only declared unambiguous numeral notation without rounding or axis exchange. Missing field -> request REJECT_PROVEN/INPUT_REQUIRED; ambiguous syntax or units -> request REJECT_PROVEN/INVALID_BRIEF.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Parse unambiguous finite W,L exactly and n as exact integer. Nonnumeric/nonfinite/ambiguous syntax is INVALID_BRIEF. If valid unambiguous syntax exceeds a declared engineering representation/precision capability, return UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED_NUMERIC_REPRESENTATION, not false invalidity, silent rounding or domain acceptance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Compute independently 5<=W<=45 and 5<=L<=45; compute n in {1,2}.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          4
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Emit input-domain acceptance only if all three true. Invoke supported handling or explicit unsupported/incompatibility result; never infer feasible geometry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط پذیرش محدود

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Exact parsing succeeds, raw-to-normalized values and axes preserved, all owner input-domain predicates true. Emits request-only input acceptance, never candidate feasibility or delivery approval.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط رد اثبات‌شده

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Request-bound proof of missing required input, ambiguous/nonnumeric/nonfinite syntax or units, noninteger/out-of-set n, or exactly parsed W/L outside owner bounds. Reject request, not geometry or feasibility.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط نامعلوم

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Unambiguous otherwise admissible numeric representation exceeds declared implementation precision/representation capability, or required request/source binding is unavailable. In-domain input with unsupported design handling is explicit unsupported, not successful feasible output.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط خارج از دامنه

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Never inapplicable for a generation request; unrelated read-only task may be outside scope.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        O-DISPLAY-FA

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        رابطه و الگوریتم دقیق

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Build required named-space inventory from actual candidate spaces; do not infer spaces from printed text.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Require exactly one canonical Persian name association per space; bind its anchor/leader to that space region, not merely nearest label. Compare assigned text with source role names and approved Persian vocabulary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Shape text with declared renderer/font; require every Unicode codepoint represented without replacement/missing glyph; check label bounding boxes against crop and recorded occlusion.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          4
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Compare visible opening/window IDs and geometry to actual candidate inventory; any extra symbol lacks authority.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Evaluate readability in every declared rendered view using recorded actual view evidence; automated glyph/bounds checks alone do not prove human readability. Missing observation remains UNKNOWN.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط پذیرش محدود

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Every required space has correct readable Persian association and every displayed opening/window binds actual same-candidate geometry in all declared views.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط رد اثبات‌شده

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A known missing/wrong/unreadable label or fake/misrepresented opening in a required view.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط نامعلوم

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Missing render/view/readability evidence or unavailable authoritative name/reference.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        شرط خارج از دامنه

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        No rendered/delivered view is claimed in this task.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        آستانه و نوع اعتبار

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          فرض‌ها

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Readability is checked in the declared actual rendered views, not by an invented universal font-size threshold.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          O-CLEAN-PRESENTATION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          رابطه و الگوریتم دقیق

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Classify objects by source semantic type, not pixel color: movable furniture, diagnostic sweep/clearance, fixed closet, wall, actual opening, label, column.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Require default visibility false for movable furniture and unrequested diagnostic overlays; require visible fixed walls/openings/closets/Persian names.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Require no modeled/displayed columns under current MVP owner scope; flag any actual column instead of hiding a physical dependency.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            4
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Compare evaluation model/evidence digest before and after presentation-only operation; evidence must remain available and unchanged.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          شرط پذیرش محدود

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No forbidden default overlays/movable furniture/columns; required fixed elements and labels retained; internal functional evidence unchanged.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          شرط رد اثبات‌شده

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Known forbidden visible object, missing fixed closet/wall/opening, or evidence removed to hide failure.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          شرط نامعلوم

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Layer/object inventory or same-candidate evidence binding missing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          شرط خارج از دامنه

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No default-render claim requested; internal diagnostic artifacts clearly private are not delivered-default views.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          آستانه و نوع اعتبار

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            فرض‌ها

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Ban is on unrequested diagnostic layers, not a fabricated prohibition of every green/yellow pixel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            وضعیت پیاده‌سازی، جدا از قرارداد

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            step5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            PARTIAL_OR_UNPROVEN; per-rule executable specification is not implementation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            step6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            UNPROVEN; no runtime/render/product tests executed in this documentary task
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            O-UI-RESPONSIVE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            رابطه و الگوریتم دقیق

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Enumerate required input,progress,rejection,accepted-result,allowed-download controls from source workflow. Declare viewport/scale/mode fixtures; their values are engineering coverage, not new owner breakpoints.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              For each view and workflow state, compute required control hit/visual rectangles against viewport/scroll containers; record clipping, occlusion and whether a finite accessible interaction reaches the control.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Trace each input update through result invalidation: result brief/version must equal current accepted brief before showing current result; stale state marked invalid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Verify required keyboard/touch actions and rejection/progress text on actual UI. For every download transition require current stage authorization and candidate identity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Compare actual style/layout against accessible approved reference; missing reference cannot be silently reported matched.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            شرط پذیرش محدود

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Every required control/action/state works in every declared device class; no stale result or unauthorized diagnostic download; approved-reference correspondence established.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            شرط رد اثبات‌شده

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A concrete required interaction/visibility failure, falsely current stale result, or forbidden download.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            شرط نامعلوم

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            No actual UI/view/interaction/reference evidence for the claim.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            شرط خارج از دامنه

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Backend-only diagnostic work makes no usable-UI completion claim.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            آستانه و نوع اعتبار

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              فرض‌ها

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Specific test viewport sizes are declared fixtures, not owner-imposed universal breakpoints.
